notes.title: Ver 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mirage: Ignis Fatuus!

In this patch, arrow keys are now functional in the menus and during gameplay.

This patch also includes the following bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed irregular rendering layers in the levels "Mt. Ignifer", "A Warm Welcome", "Hot Potato", and "The Escape".
[*] Fixed level failing when colliding with Cocky Kube.
[/list]
The following issues are known, with a planned fix in the near future:
[list]
[*] Render flickering in specific platforms of select levels in certain GPUs.
[*] Entering Settings screen in the Pause menu causes the game state to become unpaused.
[/list]
If you enjoy playing Mirage: Ignis Fatuus thus far, please help us leave a positive review on Steam!

notes.title: Ver 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mirage: Ignis Fatuus!


In this patch, we have the following general bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed irregular rendering layers in the level "A Breath of Nature".
[*] Fixed missing colliders in "Strange Mechanism" & "The Hole".
[*] Fixed item being placeable out of bounds in "The Colour of Mana" & "Cool Breeze".
[*] Fixed a minor movement logic in "Ravine".
[/list]

The following issues are known, with a fix upcoming:
[list]
[*] Render flickering in specific platforms of select levels in certain GPUs.
[*] Entering Settings screen in the Pause menu causes the game state to become unpaused.
[/list]

If you enjoy playing Mirage: Ignis Fatuus thus far, please help us leave a positive review on Steam!

notes.title: Ver 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mirage: Ignis Fatuus!

In this update, we fixed a few minor bugs in the later levels, and also expanded the Settings to include display modes, resolutions, volume sliders, and keyboard mappings.

If you enjoy the game, please remember to leave a positive review as it helps with our discovery~
